```python
def is_nested(string):
    opening = []
    closing = []
    for i, c in enumerate(string):
        if c == '[':
            opening.append(i)
        elif c == ']':
            closing.append(i)
    closing.reverse()
    count = 0
    for i, idx in enumerate(opening):
        if i < len(closing) and idx < closing[i]:
            count += 1
    return count >= 2
```
